title: Ensemble machine learning for predicting in-hospital mortality in Asian women with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).
summary: publisher full text verifies ensemble ML trained/tested on Malaysian registry cases to predict in-hospital mortality in women with STEMI and compared with TIMI; registry split is internal only.
ai_technology: An ensemble of machine-learning models uses Malaysian STEMI registry data to predict in-hospital mortality in women with STEMI and is compared with TIMI.
organization: Cardiology Department; Cardiac Vascular and Lung Research Institute; National Heart Association of Malaysia

evidence.tested: The study reports registry-based mortality prediction with an internal train/test split and comparison against TIMI.
evidence.unknown: The split is internal to one registry; external prospective validation and clinical impact are unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: An ensemble of machine-learning models uses Malaysian STEMI registry data to predict in-hospital mortality in women with STEMI and is compared with TIMI.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
